title: THE WHITE BULL'S CHARGE // BATTLE OF FIRE
narrative: The trumpet of Meereen sounds the charge. Ser Barristan Selmy rides forth in enameled silver armor upon a white charger, leading five thousand pit fighters and Unsullied through the copper gates. 'Here I am, dogs of Yunkai! Come kill an old knight if you can!' His spear shatters three slavemasters in three heartbeats as the trebuchets raining infected corpses are overturned into the dust.
resolvesPlotHole: The Battle of Fire in TWOW

options.text: Rendezvous with the newly arrived Iron Fleet in the bay.
Coordinate with Tyrion Lannister inside the Second Sons camp.
Strong Belwas's gastric fortitude: Belwas swallows forty poisoned locusts and belches loudly.
